questions.question: [C1 Atoms And Elements] Foundation Define the term compound and give one example.
questions.correctAnswer: A compound is a substance made from two or more elements that are chemically combined in fixed proportions. Example: water (H₂O) is a compound of hydrogen and oxygen.
questions.explanation: A compound is a substance made from two or more elements that are chemically combined in fixed proportions. Example: water (H₂O) is a compound of hydrogen and oxygen.

questions.question: [C1 Atoms And Elements] Foundation Explain the difference between a mixture and a compound.
questions.correctAnswer: A compound has elements chemically combined in fixed proportions and can only be separated by chemical reactions. A mixture has substances not chemically combined, with variable proportions, and can be separated by physical methods (filtration, distillation, etc.).
questions.explanation: A compound has elements chemically combined in fixed proportions and can only be separated by chemical reactions. A mixture has substances not chemically combined, with variable proportions, and can be separated by physical methods (filtration, distillation, etc.).

questions.question: [C1 Atoms And Elements] Foundation Balance the following equation: H₂ + O₂ → H₂O
questions.correctAnswer: 2H₂ + O₂ → 2H₂O. Count: Left = H: 4, O: 2; Right = H: 4, O: 2. Balanced.
questions.explanation: 2H₂ + O₂ → 2H₂O. Count: Left = H: 4, O: 2; Right = H: 4, O: 2. Balanced.

questions.question: [Concentration And Yield] Foundation 10 g of sugar is dissolved in 200 cm³ of solution. Calculate the concentration in g/dm³.
[Concentration And Yield] Foundation A reaction has a theoretical yield of 80 g. The actual yield is 60 g. Calculate the percentage yield.
[Concentration And Yield] Higher In the reaction C₂H₄ + Br₂ → C₂H₄Br₂, the desired product is C₂H₄Br₂. Calculate the atom economy. (M r : C₂H₄Br₂ = 188)
questions.correctAnswer: This is an addition reaction — there is only one product. Atom economy = (188 ÷ 188) × 100 = 100%
questions.explanation: This is an addition reaction — there is only one product. Atom economy = (188 ÷ 188) × 100 = 100%

questions.correctAnswer: Potassium, sodium, zinc, iron, copper (from most to least reactive)
questions.explanation: Potassium, sodium, zinc, iron, copper (from most to least reactive)

questions.question: [Reactivity Of Metals] Foundation Write the word equation for calcium reacting with cold water.
[Reactivity Of Metals] Higher Will magnesium displace copper from copper(II) sulfate solution? Write the balanced symbol equation if a reaction occurs.
questions.correctAnswer: Yes — magnesium is more reactive than copper, so displacement occurs. Mg(s) + CuSO₄(aq) → MgSO₄(aq) + Cu(s)
questions.explanation: Yes — magnesium is more reactive than copper, so displacement occurs. Mg(s) + CuSO₄(aq) → MgSO₄(aq) + Cu(s)
